panels.title: Targets Down
panels.description: Scrape targets that have been down for the whole of the last 5 minutes. The tiles below show which.

panels.title: Hubs Online
panels.description: Authorized hub sessions on hub-bridge.

panels.title: App Sessions
panels.description: Active sessions on client-bridge and api-bridge.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: All requests routed by Traefik.

panels.title: Ingress 5xx
panels.description: Share of Traefik responses that were 5xx over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Errors / 5m
panels.description: Log lines matching ERROR or Exception across all pods. See the Logs row for which.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Containers in the default namespace that restarted in place during the selected time range. Pods replaced by a rollout are not counted.

panels.title: Cert Expiry
panels.description: Days until the soonest-expiring certificate served by Traefik expires.

panels.title: Error Logs
panels.description: Log lines matching ERROR or Exception, per minute.
Latest log lines for the services picked in the "Service" variable, filtered by "Search" (case-insensitive regex). Viewers can read logs here without access to Explore.
panels.title: Logs
Responses by Status Class (/s)
panels.description: All requests arriving at Traefik on ports 80/443, including ones that matched no route.

panels.title: Latency by Service (excl. WebSocket)
panels.description: Average per service, plus p95 across all services. Traefik's default histogram buckets are coarse (0.1s, 0.3s, 1.2s, 5s), so the p95 is approximate.
Days until the TLS certificate served by Traefik expires. cert-manager renews 30 days before expiry, so less than 28 days means a renewal has been missed.
panels.title: TLS Certificate Expiry (days)

targets.expr: sum by (job) (rate({__name__=~"com_iris_bridge_metrics_bridge_metrics_bridge_(client|api)_http_bad_request_sent"}[5m])) + sum by (job) (rate({__name__=~"com_iris_bridge_metrics_bridge_metrics_bridge_(client|api)_http_forbidden_sent"}[5m])) + sum by (job) (rate({__name__=~"com_iris_bridge_metrics_bridge_metrics_bridge_(client|api)_http_notfound_sent"}[5m]))

panels.title: Request Latency p95
panels.description: Time spent processing each request inside the bridge, as reported by the bridge (recent window, not affected by network time).

panels.title: Requests by Endpoint (/s)
panels.description: Per-handler HTTP requests by status code. Health checks (checkpage) are excluded.

panels.title: Platform Messages (/s)
panels.description: Messages between the bridge and the platform bus.

panels.title: Hub Connect / Disconnect Events (per 5m)
panels.description: HubConnected / HubDisconnected messages seen on the platform bus.

panels.title: DAO Latency p95 (slowest op per service)
panels.description: 95th percentile Cassandra DAO time for the slowest operation of each type, per service, over the timers' recent window.

panels.title: Driver Service Tasks (/s)
panels.description: Device messages processed by driver-services.

targets.expr: sum(rate(notifications_email_error_count[5m])) by (job) + sum(rate(notifications_sms_error_count[5m])) by (job) + sum(rate(notifications_push_error_count[5m])) by (job) + sum(rate(notifications_apns_error_count[5m])) by (job) + sum(rate(notifications_gcm_error_count[5m])) by (job) + sum(rate(notifications_ivr_error_count[5m])) by (job) + sum(rate(notifications_webhook_error_count[5m])) by (job) + sum(rate(notifications_log_error_count[5m])) by (job)

panels.title: Notifications (/s)
panels.description: Errors are summed across all channels (email, sms, push, apns, gcm, ivr, webhook, log).

panels.title: Old Gen After GC (% of max)
panels.description: Old-generation heap still in use after the last collection, as a share of its max. This is live data the service cannot free, so a value that stays above 90% means it is short of heap (-Xmx). Covers both the Serial (Tenured Gen) and G1 (G1 Old Gen) collectors.
How long each container in the default namespace has been running, most recent first.
